pages.text: Firelink is Minecraft by way of $(l)Dark Souls$(): hard fights, great beasts, bonfires and Estus, and a world that would quite like you dead. It is also, on purpose, a bit silly.$(br2)The aim: survive, grow strong, take $(l)Lord Souls$() from the bosses, and build somewhere the night can't reach. You are far stronger together.
Die, learn, try again. Your gear comes back with you.
